news.title: UNI President Mark Nook voices support for federal teacher education legislation
news.summary_en: The legislation aims to strengthen the TEACH Grant Program by improving accountability, providing additional support for grant recipients and helping students successfully meet their service commitments.

news.title: Ken Brown named dean of UNI Wilson College of Business
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa has selected Ken Brown as its next dean of the David W. Wilson College of Business. Brown returns to UNI after serving as a faculty member for nearly 20 years and will begin his new role on July 15.
